description: Retrieve a Key Event by its resource name. This operation is read-only.

inputSchema.description: Request model for retrieving a Key Event in a Google Analytics 4 property.

name.description: Required. Resource name of the Key Event to retrieve. Format: properties/{property}/keyEvents/{keyEvent}.
name.title: Name

inputSchema.title: GetKeyEventRequest

name: get_key_event

currencyCode.description: Required. ISO 4217 currency code applied when unset.
currencyCode.title: Currency Code

numericValue.description: Required. Used to populate the 'value' parameter when unset.
numericValue.title: Numeric Value

countingMethod.description: Required. How key events are counted in a session.
countingMethod.title: Counting Method

createTime.description: Output only. When the key event was created, in RFC3339 format.
createTime.title: Create Time

custom.description: Output only. True if this refers to a custom event; false for a GA default event.
custom.title: Custom

defaultValue.description: Output only. Default value and currency for the key event.
defaultValue.title: Default Value

deletable.description: Output only. Whether this event can be deleted.
deletable.title: Deletable

name.description: Output only. Resource name of this key event.
name.title: Name
